about: Walking with the mouse (issue #168): the press walks at once; holding the button while the pointer sweeps around keeps walking toward it, no more often than every 300 ms; a click on a wall walks to the nearest open cell (Izlude's 2x3 block at x 141-142, y 106-108: a click on 141,107 from 135,108 goes to 140,107); Shift+click only turns to face the cell (arriving facing east, a Shift+click on 143,110, 45° aside, turns only the head: issue #357); a click on the chat log's lines (issue #174) walks too. Izlude rather than Prontera: Prontera's GAT is stored encrypted in data.grf, so it can't be read to pick a wall.
